answer: Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every orchard settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
